name: episode_camera_group_set
title: Group episode cameras
description: Explicitly assigns synchronized camera angles in one editable Episode to a stable camera group: a new opaque group when camera_group_key is omitted, an existing Episode group, or a backfill of the exact key already carried by every selected angle's active Footage-session membership. This changes only camera identity/label projection: synchronization, angle IDs, Program ranges, preview, and render resolution remain unchanged. The revision-guarded receipt retains every prior key and label for reversal.

camera_group_key.description: Optional existing group key from this Episode; a new one is created when omitted.

camera_label.description: Optional human-facing group label; never used as identity.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-stable retry key for this exact regrouping.

reason.description: Required evidence or explicit human instruction supporting the grouping.
